program_name: Nexo Affiliate Program (Affiliate track / Business track)
application_conditions: Two tracks: Business (advisers, creators, KOLs; Nexo Partner Portal) and Affiliate (affiliates and media networks; Impact). Individual review on 'audience fit, engagement, and alignment with our Value First standard'; reply 'within one business day'; no minimum audience; 'Applying takes less than a minute'.
paid_action: Share of fee revenue: trading fees, credit interest/loan volume, yield, futures; 'Nexo Card transactions' listed without a rate.

commission.model_note: Up to 50% of fee revenue ecosystem-wide: up to 50% of trading fees (Exchange), up to 50% of interest revenue or up to 4% of loan volume originated (credit), up to 10% of yield accrued, up to 50% of futures trading fees; private-client commissions "tailored". Nexo Card: "Earn with every transaction your clients make with the Nexo Card" — no rate. Rates "subject to change", vary by region and loyalty tier, maximums may depend on additional criteria. Page data "as of Q2 2026".

revenue_share.included_products: Exchange, credit, yield, futures, card (rate unstated), private clients
revenue_share.exclusions: Products not available in all jurisdictions

rules_note: Affiliate track on Impact; Business track on Nexo Partner Portal. Some products cannot be advertised freely; no channel rules published.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; product availability varies by jurisdiction.

evidence.title: Nexo Affiliate Program page + FAQ
evidence.excerpt: Two tracks; up to 50% of fee revenue; Nexo Card transactions listed as a revenue source without a rate; withdrawals every 30 days.

evidence.title: Nexo Affiliate Program page + FAQ (re-read 2026-11-10; "Latest available data as of Q2 2026")
